about: What a Number Format shows a grid, what it refuses, and what it keeps of a code (ADR-0016, ADR-0046, ADR-0047, ADR-0071). What it paints in colour is NumberFormatColourTests' to say. Transcribed from ExSheet.Engine.Tests' NumberFormatTests; a refused code's reason is the refusal's saying.

cases.name: ADR-0016/0047: a date that cannot exist cannot be shown, and shows ####: -1
ADR-0016/0047: a date that cannot exist cannot be shown, and shows ####: 2958466
ADR-0016 (SH-10): a number reports itself as a number, so a grid can show #### when it does not fit
ADR-0046: General alignment puts numbers right, text left, booleans and errors in the centre
ADR-0046: alignment is settable per cell, and changing it repaints the row without recomputing
ADR-0046: a format set on a blank cell applies to what is typed there later
